analysis: Within-record dispersion among records with ≥2 selected measurements
definition: Median absolute deviation of selected log10(kcat) measurements from each record-specific median; summary reports the median across records.
interpretation: Quantifies within-record experimental dispersion at the strongest available matching level.

analysis: Cross-database difference among records supported by both BRENDA and SABIO-RK
definition: Absolute difference between BRENDA-specific and SABIO-RK-specific median log10(kcat), summarized by the median across records.
interpretation: Measures source-specific disagreement; database support is not treated as independent replication.
